title: Bebida con Ilustración en Estilo de Pintura Regional y Composición con Etiqueta Cultural
prompt:
Location: Barcelona

A vertical composition (3:4 ratio) overhead photo. A [VESSEL TYPE] with distinct regional characteristics, holding [DRINK NAME], presented authentically in the traditional [LOCATION] style, with its central point precisely at the golden ratio intersection (e.g., upper left).

This cup/container physically overlaps and presses against the inner corner of a large, single painting-style illustration block. The subject of this illustration is intentionally arranged off-center, with visual weight leaning toward the corner opposite the cup. This is not a collage or repeating pattern, but a unified, coherent scene, enclosed within a flowing, organic, or irregular geometric boundary (never a rigid rectangle). This unique illustration adopts the distinctive painting style of [FAMOUS LOCAL ART STYLE/ARTIST], depicting the iconic natural landscapes or urban scenery of [LOCATION].

Crucially: Between the outer contour of this unique illustration shape and the physical edges of the entire square frame, there is a clear "white space margin" (about 1/3 of the frame's width/height), which serves as textured negative space. The surrounding large areas of textured, soft background tones are elegantly and directly derived from the color of [DRINK NAME] itself. In the prominent negative space, place a small, culturally characteristic auxiliary label object (such as a seal, postmark, etc.), subtly inscribed in the local language/script with "[LOCATION]" and "[DRINK NAME]".

Some unprocessed [INGREDIENT] raw materials are artistically scattered around the cup/container and along the edges of the illustration boundary. The lighting is soft, natural top lighting.
